name: plausible
description: Plausible CE (Postgres + ClickHouse): DB auto-detection dumps the Postgres (accounts, sites, settings) - the important config data. The ClickHouse event store has NO dump support here and is captured as a live file copy: parts are written atomically, so the copy is usable, but events written during the backup window can be missing (crash-consistent) - for analytics data an accepted trade-off. The create warning about ClickHouse is expected. For a strictly consistent event backup use clickhouse-backup as a pre-hook.
